items.author: celestialfr0st.bsky.social
items.context: Question of the Day: What is your favorite cozy game? For me right now that's #FieldsofMistria! I adore stardew but mistria has a far less punishing system and sense of urgency.
items.text: Less urgency is exactly what makes a cozy game feel restful. Fields of Mistria sounds like a lovely fit for that.

items.author: mixtior.bsky.social
items.context:
You plan to play for 10 minutes, and suddenly an hour is gone. Here are cozy farming and mobile games that are relaxing, heartwarming, and secretly addictive. From Harvest Town to Stardew Valley. Save this for later. Which one are you most interested in? #CozyGames #FarmingGames #MobileGames

items.text: Stardew Valley is a gentle place to start. It plays well in short, calm sessions, and it's a good one for the Steam Deck too.
